review_kind: Codex-assisted source and rationale review; not an independent human benchmark

rubric.criterion: Context changes the permitted next step
rubric.evidence: Real Groq selects a missing web import for HTTP, and review/stop for SSH, conflicting port states and unavailable web imports.
All chosen and rejected candidate citations are validated against the recorded context and relevant candidate IDs.

rubric.criterion: Reasoning explains information gain and alternatives
rubric.evidence: The HTTP case explains the missing web evidence and alternative import choices; review cases explain uncertainty/conflict. Proposed benefits are hypotheses, not guarantees that imported output will contain findings.

rubric.criterion: Uncertainty and human authority remain explicit
rubric.evidence: No confirmed findings or execution authority are created. Review/stop decisions remain blocked and active validation requires its separate approval mechanism.

rubric.criterion: Repeated work and unavailable dependencies are handled honestly
rubric.evidence: Duplicate context requests are suppressed without model calls; unsupported tools are excluded and failed calls return stable reasons without automatic retries.

limitations: Synthetic normalized fixtures do not prove genuine scanner coverage or T30 acceptance.
Provider/model validity is dated and account-specific; no accuracy, calibration or winning guarantee is made.
Production key/policy activation on Render is separate from this software and live-provider acceptance record.
Advanced durable graph memory and broad cost/performance evaluation remain later issues.
